description: HR-48 RTO is the Regional Transport Office located in Tosham, functioning as a Regional Licensing Authority (RLA) under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate office. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and transport regulation for the Tosham sub-division of Haryana. This RTO helps decentralized transport administration in the Bhiwani district by serving local rural and semi-urban populations.
address: SDM Office, Tosham, District Bhiwani, Haryana
